useHDRPeakBrightness.help: Whether HDRPeakBrightness should be used to override the monitor's detected peak brightness level.

useMaxFPSBk.help: Enables or disables background FPS limit

vrsParticles.help: Render scale like effect for particles. Only used if lots of particles are on screen

vrsValarAlwaysOn.help: Use VRS even when not GPU bound

vrsValarGPUMode.help: 0 - Auto-detect, 1 - Standard (discrete GPU default), 2 - Low Power (integrated GPU default) modes for VALAR

vrsValarLPUseCornerSampling.help: Use corner sampling for VALAR Low Power

vrsWorldGeo.help: Render scale like effect for terrain, buildings and liquids

wmoLodDistScale.help: Wmo level of detail distance scale

worldLoadSort.help: Sort objects by distance when loading

worldPreloadHighResTextures.help: Require high res textures to be loaded in streaming non critical radius when preloading

worldPreloadNonCritical.help: Require objects to be loaded in streaming non critical radius when preloading

worldPreloadNonCriticalTimeout.help: World preload time (in seconds) when non-critical items are automatically ignored

worldPreloadSort.help: Sort objects by distance when preloading

allowDevPublicKey.help: Enable to allow the use of the Dev key instead of the one sourced from static.

enableBGDL.help: Background Download (on async net thread) Enabled

maximumConnectionAttempts.help: Maximum number of times to try to connect to a server using QUIC before doing TCP

portal.help: Name of Battle.net portal to use

serverAlert.help: Get the glue-string tag for the URL

useBLEEP.help: Client override to always prefer BLEEP, when available

useIPv6.help: Enable the usage of IPv6 sockets

BlizzCon2026Experience.help: Which experience the system is currently targeting.

InputDeviceInterfaceStyle.help: Switches between the interface types for different devices

KioskCanAutoDeleteCharacters.help: Determines if characters will be deleted after a session restart. Defaults to 'true'.

KioskCanSessionExpire.help: Determines if a Kiosk session can expire. Defaults to 'true'.

KioskCharacterTemplateSet1.help: Character template set ID 1 to select at character creation. Defaults to 0.

KioskCharacterTemplateSet2.help: Character template set ID 2 to select at character creation. Defaults to 0.

KioskLobbyKickSeconds.help: Seconds until an expired session kicks the player back to the lobby. Defaults to 30.

KioskWarmupSeconds.help: Seconds to lockdown controls on the welcome screen. Defaults to 15.

PreventOsIdleSleep.help: Enable this to prevent the computer from idle sleeping while the game is running

ThreadPoolLimitHP.help: Limit num threads for High prio jobs

ThreadPoolLimitLP.help: Limit num threads for Low prio jobs

ThreadPoolLimitMP.help: Limit num threads for Mid prio jobs

alwaysShowRuneIcons.help: Show the rune icons on equipment at all times, as opposed to only when the rune UI is open.

housingExpertGizmos_Scale_FrameOffset.help: Y Offset of scale frame from target

housingExpertGizmos_Scale_Snap.help: Amount scale should snap (0.1 being 10%, 1 being 100%, etc)

housingExpertGizmos_SnapOnHold.help: true: Holding shift turns expert control snapping on, false: Holding shift turns snapping off

housingLayout_Camera_DefaultDistance.help: Default height of the layout edit mode camera above the floor

housingLayout_Camera_DragFriction.help: How quickly the camera loses drag momentum

housingLayout_Camera_DragMomentum.help: How much momentum does the camera have after the user stops dragging

housingLayout_Camera_MaxDistance.help: Maximum height of the layout edit mode camera above the floor

housingLayout_Camera_MaxDistanceIncr.help: How much zoom in/out of the layout edit mode camera affects distance from the floor

housingLayout_Camera_MinDistance.help: Minimum height of the layout edit mode camera above the floor

housingLayout_Camera_Smoothness.help: Smoothness factor of layout camera movement

housingLayout_Camera_Speed.help: Units/second that the layout edit mode camera moves

PushToTalkSound.help: Play a sound when voice recording activates and deactivates

SoundPerf_VariationCap.help: Limit sound kit variations to cut down on memory usage and disk thrashing on 32-bit machines

Sound_AllyPlayerHighpassDSPCutoff.help: The cutoff value to use for the Highpass filter on the Ally Player bus (default 80 Hz)

Sound_AlternateListener.help: When enabled, calculates listener forward by simply using the camera's yaw value, instead of a vector from camera position to listener position

Sound_AmbienceHighpassDSPCutoff.help: The cutoff value to use for the Highpass filter on the Ambience bus (default 100 Hz)

Sound_EnablePositionalLowPassFilter.help: Environmental effect to make sounds duller behind you or far away

Sound_EnableSoundWhenGameIsInBG.help: Enable Sound When Game Is In Background

Sound_EnemyPlayerHighpassDSPCutoff.help: The cutoff value to use for the Highpass filter on the Enemy Player bus (default 80 Hz)

Sound_MaxCacheableSizeInBytes.help: Max sound size that will be cached, larger files will be streamed instead

Sound_NPCHighpassDSPCutoff.help: The cutoff value to use for the Highpass filter on the NPC bus (default 80 Hz)

VoiceChatMasterVolumeScale.help: Voice Chat audio ducking, applied as a scale to the game's master volume when somebody is speaking in voice chat

VoiceCommunicationMode.help: Which communication mode to use for voice chat: push-to-talk, open mic, etc...

VoiceEnableWhenGameIsInBG.help: Enable Voice Chat when game is in background

VoiceInputDevice.help: Which deviceID you would like to use to pick up the sound of your wonderful voice, usually a microphone of some kind, empty string is system default

VoiceInputVolume.help: The gain applied to your microphone, helps change your speaking volume from other users' perspectives, larger values are louder.

VoiceOutputDevice.help: Which deviceID you would like to use to transmit the sound of other users' wonderful voices, usually a speakers of some kind, empty string is system default

VoiceOutputVolume.help: The volume of incoming voice chat, how loud other users' voices sound

VoiceVADSensitivity.help: How sensitive voice activity detection is.  Value ranges from 0 to 100, smaller values will transmit at a lower noise threshold.

autojoinBGVoice.help: Automatically join the voice session in battleground chat

autojoinPartyVoice.help: Automatically join the voice session in party/raid chat
